items.heading: Mas Huni
details: Key ingredients: shredded tuna, coconut, onion, lime, chili
Shred cooked or smoked tuna finely.
Mix with freshly grated coconut, diced onion and chili.
Squeeze in fresh lime juice.
Serve with roshi flatbread for breakfast.

items.heading: Garudhiya
details: Key ingredients: tuna, water, lime, chili, curry leaves
Simmer chunks of tuna in water with curry leaves until cooked through.
Season simply with salt.
Serve the clear fish broth with rice.
Add a squeeze of lime and chopped chili and onion at the table.
